srcZh: 国家知识产权局商标局
titleZh: 关于启用尼斯分类第十二版2025文本的通知
titleEn: Notice on Adopting the 12th Edition (2025 Text) of the Nice Classification
sumZh: 宣布自2025年1月1日起正式使用《商标注册用商品和服务国际分类》（尼斯分类）第十二版2025文本，并公布据此调整后的《类似商品和服务区分表》修改内容。
sumEn: Announces adoption of the Nice Classification 12th Edition (2025 text) from 2025-01-01 and publishes the corresponding adjustments to the Classification of Similar Goods and Services.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局商标局关于启用尼斯分类第十三版2026文本的通知
titleEn: Notice on Adopting the 13th Edition (2026 Text) of the Nice Classification
sumZh: 转发商标局通知，明确自2026年1月1日起使用尼斯分类第十三版2026文本，申请日在此之后的商标注册适用新版本，并公布区分表修改内容。
sumEn: Relays the Trademark Office notice on adopting the Nice Classification 13th Edition (2026 text) from 2026-01-01 and the revised Classification of Similar Goods and Services.

srcZh: 通辽市市场监督管理局
titleZh: 商标局：2026年1月1日起启用《商标注册用商品和服务国际分类》第十三版2026文本
titleEn: Trademark Office to Adopt Nice Classification 13th Edition (2026 Text) from 2026-01-01
sumZh: 转载商标局关于启用尼斯分类第十三版2026文本的通知，说明新旧版本的适用规则及《类似商品和服务区分表》的调整。
sumEn: Reprints the Trademark Office notice on the 13th Edition (2026 text), explaining version applicability rules and adjustments to the classification table.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标分类表下载途径
titleEn: Reply: How to Obtain the Trademark Classification Table
sumZh: 回复公众如何获取最新商标分类表，指引在中国商标网“商品和服务分类”栏目下载基于尼斯分类第十二版（2024文本）的区分表及NCL12-2025修改内容。
sumEn: Explains where to download the latest classification table, pointing to the Similar Goods and Services Classification and NCL12-2025 amendment files on the China Trademark Website.

srcZh: 西安市知识产权保护中心
titleZh: 关于启用尼斯分类第十二版2025文本的通知
titleEn: Notice on Adopting the 12th Edition (2025 Text) of the Nice Classification
sumZh: 西安知产保护中心转发商标局通知，说明2025年1月1日起适用尼斯分类第十二版2025文本及区分表修改内容。
sumEn: Republishes the Trademark Office notice on the 12th Edition (2025 text) taking effect from 2025-01-01 and the classification table changes.

titleZh: 商标分类表1-45类2026最新版：商标被注册类别选择指南与尼斯分类第13版解读
titleEn: 2026 Trademark Classification (Classes 1-45): Category Selection Guide and Nice Classification 13th Edition Explained
sumZh: 系统解读尼斯分类第13版2026文本的由来、45大类划分、2026年核心调整（如眼镜迁至第10类、AI及元宇宙新增项目）及类别选择策略与常见误区。
sumEn: Explains the origin and 45-class structure of the Nice Classification, key 13th-Edition changes (eyewear moved to Class 10, new AI/metaverse items) and category selection strategies.

titleZh: 国家商标注册分类详解（2026年最新，适配尼斯分类12版）
titleEn: A Detailed Guide to China's Trademark Registration Classification (2026, Nice Classification 12th Edition)
sumZh: 梳理尼斯分类45大类框架（1-34类商品、35-45类服务）、重点类别范围与典型示例，以及商标申报的注意事项和常见误区。
sumEn: Outlines the 45-class Nice framework (Classes 1-34 goods, 35-45 services), key class scopes with examples, and common filing mistakes.

titleZh: 2026年商标尼斯分类第13版即将生效！这些行业要赶紧自查
titleEn: Nice Classification 13th Edition Takes Effect in 2026: Industries Should Self-Check Now
sumZh: 介绍尼斯分类第13版2026文本的新增项目（生物燃料、可穿戴健康设备、AI营销等）与商品跨类迁移（眼镜、电热服装等），并提示无需追溯过往申请。
sumEn: Introduces new items and cross-class migrations in the 13th Edition, reminding applicants that prior applications are not retroactively affected.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标注册流程
titleEn: Reply: Trademark Registration Procedures
sumZh: 说明申请注册商标的三种途径，包括自行通过商标网上服务系统在线提交、到商标业务受理窗口或注册大厅办理、以及委托备案代理机构办理。
sumEn: Explains three filing routes: online via the trademark service system, at service windows or the registration hall, or through a recorded agency.

titleZh: 留言回复：如何进行网上商标注册
titleEn: Reply: How to Register a Trademark Online
sumZh: 指引申请人通过商标网上服务系统在线提交商标注册申请，提交方法详见中国商标网“网上申请”栏目。
sumEn: Guides applicants to file trademark applications online via the trademark service system, as detailed under the Online Application section of the China Trademark Website.

titleZh: 关于新商标网上申请系统上线运行的通知
titleEn: Notice on the Launch of the New Trademark Online Application System
sumZh: 明确2025年10月20日上线新商标网上申请系统，介绍统一身份认证、新系统访问地址、商标网上服务小程序及原系统停机安排等事项。
sumEn: Announces the new online application system launching 2025-10-20, covering unified identity authentication, access address, the new mini-program and old-system downtime.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局商标局
titleZh: 关于推行商标业务全面电子化的通告
titleEn: Announcement on Fully Digitalizing Trademark Business
sumZh: 宣布自2026年7月1日起委托代理机构的商标业务原则上应通过商标网上服务系统提交电子材料，网上申请享受九折优惠、变更业务免费，并设过渡期。
sumEn: Requires electronic filing for agency-handled trademark business from 2026-07-01, grants a 10% online discount (free change applications) and sets a transition period.

titleZh: 7月1日起！商标局推行商标业务全面电子化（附提交指引）
titleEn: Trademark Office to Fully Digitalize Trademark Business from July 1 (with Filing Guide)
sumZh: 转载商标局全面电子化通告并附《商标业务电子证据提交指引》，解读电子材料提交、费用优惠及过渡期安排。
sumEn: Reprints the digitalization announcement with the Electronic Evidence Filing Guide, explaining e-filing requirements, fee discounts and the transition period.

titleZh: 带你10分钟“玩转”新商标网上申请系统
titleEn: Master the New Trademark Online Application System in 10 Minutes
sumZh: 以图文攻略介绍新商标网上申请系统的进入、注册登录、历史账号关联、经办人填写及小程序数字证书验证等操作流程。
sumEn: A step-by-step illustrated guide to entering, registering, linking legacy accounts, adding handlers and completing mini-program digital certificate verification in the new system.

titleZh: 2026新商标网上申请系统使用指南：从注册到提交全流程详解
titleEn: 2026 New Trademark Online Application System Guide: Full Process from Registration to Filing
sumZh: 详解新商标网上申请系统的账号注册、实名认证、注册申请填写、材料上传、在线缴费及进度查询全流程，并说明网上申请九折优惠。
sumEn: Details account registration, real-name verification, application filling, document upload, online payment and status tracking in the new system, plus the online fee discount.

srcZh: 中国国际贸易促进委员会
srcEn: China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT)
titleZh: 《商标注册申请快速审查办法》重点问题一问一答
titleEn: Q&A on Key Issues of the Measures for Expedited Examination of Trademark Registration Applications
sumZh: 解读2025年修订的《商标注册申请快速审查办法》，明确适用范围、可申请商标类型、材料要求及20个工作日审结等时限规定。
sumEn: Interprets the 2025 revised Measures, clarifying applicable scenarios, eligible mark types, material requirements and the 20-working-day examination limit.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局公告（第634号）商标注册申请快速审查办法
titleEn: CNIPA Announcement No.634: Measures for Expedited Examination of Trademark Registration Applications
sumZh: 公布修订后的《商标注册申请快速审查办法》，列举战略性新兴产业、重大赛事、现代化产业体系等可请求快速审查的情形及程序。
sumEn: Publishes the revised Measures, listing eligible scenarios such as strategic emerging industries, major events and modern industrial systems, plus the procedure.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局办公室关于加强商标使用管理的通知
titleEn: Notice of CNIPA Office on Strengthening Trademark Use Management
sumZh: 部署加强对欺骗性使用、冒充注册商标、突出使用“驰名商标”字样、违规使用集体证明商标等违法违规行为的监管，引导规范使用商标。
sumEn: Deploys stronger oversight of deceptive use, fake registration marks, misuse of well-known mark wording and collective/certification mark violations.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标证书地址如何变更
titleEn: Reply: How to Change the Address on a Trademark Certificate
sumZh: 根据商标法第四十一条说明注册人名义、地址或其他注册事项变更须提出变更申请，并介绍电子申请及窗口、大厅、代理机构等办理途径。
sumEn: Explains that name, address or other registration changes require a change application under Article 41, and lists online, window, hall and agency routes.

titleZh: 留言回复：撤销连续三年不使用注册商标
titleEn: Reply: Cancellation of a Registered Mark Not Used for Three Consecutive Years
sumZh: 说明撤销连续三年不使用注册商标的收费标准（纸质500元/类、电子450元/类）及申请书、初步调查证据、身份证明等申请材料。
sumEn: Explains the fees (paper 500/class, electronic 450/class) and required documents for cancellation applications, including the form and preliminary evidence.

titleZh: 商标局修订完善撤销连续三年不使用注册商标申请指南（知识产权报）
titleEn: Trademark Office Revises the Guide on Cancellation for Three-Year Non-Use (China IP News)
sumZh: 介绍修订后的撤三申请指南，进一步明确应提交书件并细化被申请商标三年不使用的初步调查证据范围，以提高申请效率。
sumEn: Introduces the revised cancellation guide clarifying required documents and the scope of preliminary evidence of non-use to improve filing efficiency.

titleZh: 申请撤销无正当理由连续三年不使用注册商标
titleEn: Applying to Cancel a Registered Mark Not Used for Three Consecutive Years Without Justification
sumZh: 全文刊发修订后的撤三申请指南，涵盖法律依据、办理途径、申请材料、具体要求、规费缴纳及注意事项等内容。
sumEn: Publishes the full revised cancellation guide covering legal basis, routes, materials, requirements, fees and cautions.

titleZh: 知识产权科普之商标
titleEn: IP Popularization: Trademarks
sumZh: 科普什么是商标、商标权、R与TM标记的区别、不得作为商标注册的标志，以及商标有效期10年、续展与宽展期等基本知识。
sumEn: Explains what a trademark and trademark right are, the difference between R and TM, unregistrable signs, and the 10-year term with renewal and grace periods.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标变更名义地址问题
titleEn: Reply: Changing the Registrant's Name and Address
sumZh: 解答商标变更名义、地址所需上传的证明文件，明确变更名义上传市场监管部门变更核准证明、变更地址上传新营业执照扫描件。
sumEn: Clarifies the documents for name and address changes: the market regulator's change approval for name changes and the new business license for address changes.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标续展
titleEn: Reply: Trademark Renewal
sumZh: 根据商标法第四十条说明注册商标有效期十年，期满前十二个月内办理续展、可享六个月宽展期，并介绍续展的申请流程与网址。
sumEn: Explains the 10-year term, the 12-month renewal window, the 6-month grace period and the renewal application process and website.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标宽展和续展
titleEn: Reply: Trademark Renewal and Grace Period
sumZh: 说明注册商标有效期满需继续使用应在期满前十二个月内办理续展，未能办理的给予六个月宽展期，可在商标网申系统续展申请模块办理。
sumEn: Explains the 12-month renewal window and 6-month grace period, and that renewal can be handled in the online renewal module.

srcZh: 威海市市场监督管理局
titleZh: 商标续展申请指南
titleEn: Guide to Trademark Renewal Applications
sumZh: 列出公司与个体户窗口办理商标续展所需材料、续展费450元与迟延费225元标准，以及到期前一年内可办续展、逾期超六个月失效等规定。
sumEn: Lists renewal materials for companies and individual businesses, fees (450 yuan plus 225 yuan late fee) and the timing rules for renewal and invalidation.

titleZh: 申请续展注册商标需要提交哪些材料？
titleEn: What Materials Are Required to Apply for Trademark Renewal?
sumZh: 说明续展注册商标应提交《商标续展注册申请书》、身份证明文件、代理委托书等材料及共有商标、异议商标有效期起算等具体要求。
sumEn: Explains renewal materials (application form, ID documents, power of attorney) and special rules for co-owned and opposed marks.

titleZh: 知识产权小知识：商标续展期、宽展期、保护期
titleEn: IP Basics: Trademark Renewal Period, Grace Period and Protection Term
sumZh: 以实例说明商标续展期（期满前12个月）、宽展期（期满后6个月）的起算与费用，并介绍期满未续展后一年保护期的补救机制。
sumEn: Illustrates the 12-month renewal window and 6-month grace period with examples, plus the one-year protection period for remedying lapsed marks.

titleZh: 商标10年有效期到了怎么办？商标续展图文流程介绍
titleEn: What to Do When the 10-Year Trademark Term Expires: An Illustrated Renewal Guide
sumZh: 以图文形式介绍商标续展的核查有效期、准备材料、提交申请、缴纳费用到等待审查的完整流程及线上操作步骤。
sumEn: An illustrated guide to the full renewal process from checking the term and preparing materials to filing, paying fees and awaiting review.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标转让
titleEn: Reply: Trademark Assignment
sumZh: 说明公司注销后商标转让给个体工商户的操作流程、办理途径及《转让/移转申请/注册商标申请书》等申请材料。
sumEn: Explains how to assign a mark after company deregistration, the filing routes and required documents such as the assignment application form.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标授权（使用许可）
titleEn: Reply: Trademark Licensing (Authorized Use)
sumZh: 根据商标法第四十三条说明许可他人使用注册商标应在许可合同有效期内向商标局备案，并介绍使用许可备案的办理途径与再许可等手续。
sumEn: Explains that licenses must be recorded with the Trademark Office within the contract term, and the routes for license recordal and sub-licensing.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标转让流程
titleEn: Reply: Trademark Assignment Procedures
sumZh: 根据商标法第四十二条说明转让注册商标应由转让人与受让人共同办理，介绍转让、移转手续及网上系统、窗口、大厅等办理途径。
sumEn: Explains that assignment requires joint handling by assignor and assignee under Article 42, and lists online, window and hall routes for assignment and transfer.

titleZh: 留言回复：商标转让流程及费用
titleEn: Reply: Trademark Assignment Procedures and Fees
sumZh: 介绍商标转让的办理途径、申请书件及网上申请一标一类450元的收费标准，转让完成后发送转让核准证明。
sumEn: Explains assignment routes and documents, the 450-yuan online fee per mark per class, and issuance of the assignment approval certificate.

titleZh: 2024年11月留言回复：商标许可授权
titleEn: November 2024 Reply: Trademark Licensing and Authorization
sumZh: 回复同一法人名下商标许可给其一家公司使用是否须备案，明确许可他人使用注册商标应在许可合同有效期内向国家知识产权局备案并报送材料。
sumEn: Clarifies that licensing a registered mark to others requires recordal with CNIPA within the license term and submission of recordal materials.

titleZh: 商标局：以地理标志作为证明商标、集体商标注册申请十五问
titleEn: Trademark Office: 15 Questions on Registering Geographical Indications as Certification or Collective Marks
sumZh: 以问答形式解答地理标志证明/集体商标的申请人资格、授权文件、商品表述、含硒标志、证明材料、使用管理规则及外国申请人等十五个常见问题。
sumEn: Answers 15 common questions on GI certification/collective marks covering applicant eligibility, authorization documents, product descriptions, evidence and management rules.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局令（第79号）集体商标、证明商标注册和管理规定
titleEn: CNIPA Order No.79: Provisions on Registration and Administration of Collective and Certification Marks
sumZh: 公布2024年2月1日施行的《集体商标、证明商标注册和管理规定》，规范集体/证明商标的注册、使用管理、含地名正当使用及监督管理等内容。
sumEn: Publishes the Provisions effective 2024-02-01 regulating registration, use management, fair use of place names and supervision of collective and certification marks.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局商标局
titleZh: 《集体商标、证明商标注册和管理规定》制定说明
titleEn: Explanation on the Formulation of the Provisions on Collective and Certification Marks
sumZh: 说明《集体商标、证明商标注册和管理规定》的制定背景、原则思路、过程及主要内容，聚焦含地名商标注册与正当使用、注册人管理义务等。
sumEn: Explains the background, principles and main content of the Provisions, focusing on place-name marks, fair use and registrant management duties.

titleZh: 申请注册证明商标或集体商标指南
titleEn: Guide to Applying for Certification or Collective Mark Registration
sumZh: 介绍证明商标与集体商标的概念、地理标志关系、办理途径、申请条件流程、申请材料、注册规费及补正程序与注意事项。
sumEn: Explains certification and collective marks, GI relationships, filing routes, materials, fees, correction procedures and cautions.

titleZh: 地理标志证明商标、集体商标注册申请所需提交书件目录及说明
titleEn: Checklist and Explanation of Documents for GI Certification and Collective Mark Registration
sumZh: 列出地理标志证明/集体商标注册申请需提交的申请书、主体资格证明、政府授权文件、客观存在及信誉证明、地域范围文件等书件。
sumEn: Lists the documents required for GI mark registration, including the application form, qualifications, government authorization and evidence of existence and reputation.

titleZh: 科普！地理标志专用标志如何规范使用
titleEn: Popular Science: How to Properly Use the Special Geographical Indication Mark
sumZh: 科普地理标志专用标志的定义、合法使用人范围、标示方法、规范使用要求（标注统一社会信用代码等）及不规范使用的风险。
sumEn: Explains the GI special mark's definition, authorized users, labeling methods, usage requirements (e.g. unified social credit code) and misuse risks.

srcZh: 阿里地区市场监督管理局
srcEn: Ali Prefecture Administration for Market Regulation
titleZh: 地理标志专用标志规范使用政策解读
titleEn: Policy Interpretation on Proper Use of the Special Geographical Indication Mark
sumZh: 解读地理标志专用标志的合法使用主体、规范使用要求（标注统一社会信用代码、商标注册号等）及禁止和监管要求。
sumEn: Interprets authorized GI mark users, proper usage requirements (credit code, registration number) and prohibitions and supervision.

titleZh: 张继焦：加大老字号知识产权保护力度（知识产权报）
titleEn: Zhang Jijiao: Strengthen IP Protection for Time-Honored Brands (China IP News)
sumZh: 政协委员张继焦建议开辟老字号专属绿色通道、建立全国老字号侵权黑名单数据库、化解历史权属纠纷并支持老字号出海。
sumEn: CPPCC member Zhang Jijiao proposes green channels for time-honored brands, a national infringement blacklist, resolving historical ownership disputes and supporting overseas expansion.

srcZh: 中华老字号数字博物馆
titleZh: 以司法之力为“老字号”保驾护航
titleEn: Judicial Protection Safeguards Time-Honored Brands
sumZh: 以天津烤鸭店“八一三”、亨得利“享得利”、起士林加盟等案例，介绍天津一中院依法审理涉老字号案件、护航老字号的司法实践。
sumEn: Using Tianjin cases (e.g. Baiyisan, Hengdeli and Qishilin), describes the court's judicial protection of time-honored brands against unfair competition.

titleZh: 耿福能：协同监管，破解字号与商标权利冲突（知识产权报）
titleEn: Geng Funeng: Coordinated Regulation to Resolve Name-Trademark Right Conflicts (China IP News)
sumZh: 人大代表耿福能建议建立老字号保护跨部门联席会议制度、推行字号与商标交叉检索机制、强化变更备案管理并建立快速调处通道。
sumEn: Deputy Geng Funeng proposes a cross-departmental conference mechanism, name-trademark cross-search, change filing management and fast dispute resolution for time-honored brands.

sumEn: Reports Geng Funeng's proposals to link time-honored brand, enterprise name and trademark databases and streamline conflict resolution.

sumEn: An interview with Zhang Ping on how the new Trademark Law eases proof burdens, confirms well-known facts and curbs bad-faith squatting to protect time-honored brands.
